products.title: Getting To The 10th Planet by Zach Maslany
products.body:
Learn to Navigate Your Way Into Essential 10th Planet Systems and Give Your overall BJJ Game a Unique Upgrade Featuring Eddie Bravo Black Belt Zach Maslany
  • Zach Maslany is a Black Belt under the legendary Eddie Bravo, co-founder of 10th Planet Bethlehem in Pennsylvania, and co-founder of Finishers Only Grappling Tournament
  • Get an introduction to 4 of 10th Planet’s most essential attacking platforms, the truck, rubber guard, spider web, and the lockdown all with step by step guidance from a respected 10th Planet Black Belt helping you through the process
  • If you're new to the 10th Planet systems, Maslany will help you gain a greater understanding of those 10P terms you hear around the gym but have never had the opportunity to try
  • Utilize these specific 10P positions to add completely different dimensions to your game
  • Transition from positions you already know like mount and the x guard seamlessly into the truck, rubber guard, lockdown, and spiderweb as you learn the subsequent attacks and utilities of these dynamic 10P systems

products.title: Kimura Control by Kyle Boehm
products.body:
Master The 10th Planet Kimura System - The 10th Planet Specialty That Requires Zero Flexibility To Work From Top Or Bottom

  • Learn how you can control and tap people with the kimura from BJJ Fanatics Invitational Champion & 10th Planet Instructor Kyle Boehm
  • Kyle shows all of his favorite ways to get the kimura, and what he does when he’s there to finish fights at the elite level
  • Kyle is the winner of the BJJ Fanatics Invitational brown and black belt tournaments
  • With innovative and creative entries from top, bottom, and standing, find your way to some of 10th-Planet’s best positions

Master The 10th Planet Kimura System - The 10th Planet Specialty That Requires Zero Flexibility To Work From Top Or Bottom

Learn how you can control and tap people with the kimura from BJJ Fanatics Invitational Champion & 10th Planet Instructor Kyle Boehm


Ashi Entry From Collar Tie:

What Will You Learn?

Learn the rock-solid 10th-Planet kimura system from Eddie Bravo black belt and instructor Kyle Boehm, the winner of the inaugural BJJ Fanatics submission-only tournament. Attack the tap and lock them down with these out of this world combinations and finishes to all of 10th-Planet’s signature positions. Kyle shows all of his favorite ways to get the kimura, and what he does when he’s there to finish fights at the elite level. Now you can use one of grappling’s most important holds with the secrets from 10th Planet, from two-time BJJ Fanatics champion Kyle Boehm.

Kyle Boehm put himself on the map with a big win at the submission-only open weight tournament that we held, beating some super tough fighters to bring home the gold. Then, he got promoted to black belt and won our black belt tournament too!!! In a bracket with great fighters like Hulk Barbosa, Nicky Rod, and more, Kyle emerged as the champion. What impressed everyone the most as not just how aggressive Kyle was about looking for submissions, but also how technical he was in all of his positions and escapes. Now, you can learn his specialties, including the killer double wrist lock kimura series that is his best stuff.

With innovative and creative entries from top, bottom, and standing, find your way to some of 10th-Planet’s best positions and systematically work for the victory. Transition to spider-web control, dynamic back takes, and more with Kyle’s technical coaching, full of the little details that make this system unique to him and his team. Get this elite competitor’s blueprint to success with this step-by-step manual on how to control anyone with the kimura.

This is a submission series that is proven to work on our own BJJ Fanatics mats, and we are so excited for Kyle to be sharing his details for success with everyone. These moves don’t take any of 10th-Planet’s famous flexibility to work, they can be used by anyone (even against grapplers much bigger and stronger). Combine these powerful attacks with Kyle’s favorite ways to finish fights and give yourself a go-to lock that works on everyone.

Rolling Kimura

products.title: Mount Dominance by Brandon McCaghren
products.body:
Develop a More Dominant Mount and Learn The “Musts” of The No Gi Top Game Featuring 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor, Brandon McCaghren
  • Brandon McCaghren is a black belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most acclaimed instructors, staking his claim as the first 10P instructor in the Southeastern United States
  • Take an unorthodox approach to some classic jiu-jitsu themes, and revolutionize the way you attack from one of BJJ’s most underutilized positions, all with a 10th Planet Black Belt at the helm
  • The mount is an entirely different animal in no gi and we must adapt our games to reflect these major differences so we can still dominate from this important position
  • Learn superior body positioning tactics that you’ve never seen before so you can transform your no gi mount game from average to extraordinary
  • Explore a densely packed instructional that includes positional guidance, tons of submissions, finishing mechanics, mount maintenance strategies, and more all with the added 10th Planet flare that you’ll only get from a seasoned 10P black belt
  • Discover the spiderweb, the mounted rubber guard sugar hold, the punch choke, mounted triangle gold, multiple back takes, the chopping block, and more, all with exquisite details and guidance you won’t find anywhere else

products.title: No Gi Defense & Escapes by Kyle Boehm
products.body:
Learn The Positional and Submission Escapes Kyle Boehm Used To Go Undefeated - 10-0 In 2 Bjj Fanatics EBI Rules Tournaments

  • Become a real escape artist with these techniques for getting out from some of no-gi grappling’s most dangerous positions and submissions
  • Make your defense bulletproof as Kyle Boehm, a black belt and instructor at 10th Planet, shows the 10th Planet defenses and escapes he has used to so much success in EBI rulesets.
  • With these systems, you can now take any position and learn how a black belt no-gi expert solves these problems with technique.


Learn The Positional and Submission Escapes Kyle Boehm Used To Go Undefeated - 10-0 In 2 Bjj Fanatics EBI Rules Tournaments

Escape From Anywhere With The Important Concept Of Reverse Engineering From 10th Planet Black Belt Kyle Boehm

What Will You Learn?

Become a real escape artist with these techniques for getting out from some of no-gi grappling’s most dangerous positions and submissions, with BJJ Fanatics double champion Kyle Boehm’s guide to escaping and countering. Kyle Boehm won both the brown belt and black belt BJJ Fanatics tournaments, relying on his strong submission arsenal and these exact techniques for escaping against elite competitors. Now, his secrets can be yours on this 2-volume series packed with ways to unlock some of the most dangerous spots in Brazilian jiu-jitsu.

Make your defense bulletproof as Kyle Boehm, a black belt and instructor at 10th Planet, shows the 10th Planet defenses and escapes he has used to so much success in EBI rulesets. Kyle explains his method of reverse engineering, taking a position and working backwards out of it to safety (the same system he used against Lucas “Hulk” Barbosa and Tex Johnson in the Fanatics Grand Prix). With these systems, you can now take any position and learn how a black belt no-gi expert solves these problems with technique.


These two volumes are packed with keys to getting out of some of the worst positions in grappling, including how to get out of dangerous leg lock entanglements with precision and safety. Kyle shows counters and escapes from outside ashi, 50/50, and honey hole positions, including ways to turn it into your submission or pass. With Kyle’s help, you don’t have to fear getting trapped in some leg lock you didn’t see coming, instead you can make that position yours to win.

See the escapes that have let Kyle dominate in EBI overtimes, including ways to get out from airtight back attacks and spiderweb positions. Kyle has some of the most effective back escapes in the world and with these keys you will understand why he’s so good there. Now you can follow the same paths out that he always finds with these 2-volumes of helpful details. Even from the armbar/juji gatame/spider-web position that EBI players love, Kyle has systematic approaches to untying himself and getting out with both arms safe.

Escaping from bad positions and submissions is one of the most important aspects to submission grappling, the ability to survive under even the worst circumstances. Now, one of the best in the game at that is teaching the tricky but effective 10th Planet systems for escapes that let you reverse engineer the problems and come up with the solutions that will get you back in the fight.

So What Do You Get?

Volume 1:

  • Introduction and theory of reverse engineering
  • Back escape preemptively killing the hook & Back escape from body triangle 
  • Dilemma of defeating two controls
  • Defeating spiderweb/ juji gatame
  • Sliding top leg off of head 
  • Escaping ashi garami to neutral & Escaping ashi garami to reverse knee on belly 
  • Outside ashi garami defense to outside ashi garami offense

Volume 2:

  • Passing outside ashi garami w/ head and arm control
  • Defensive position from outside ashi garami & Heel slip from ashi garami
  • 411/Honey Hole/Double Trouble escape 
  • Game over escape 
  • 50/50 escape 
  • Reverse engineering leg lock offense 
  • Reverse engineering back control 
  • Reverse engineering spiderweb/juji gatame 
  • Conclusion 

So What Does It All Cost?

$47
